name: Adios
classification_notes: Rounded, cut-corner geometric capitals built primarily for display use, offered across five widths rather than multiple weights.
summary: A geometric display face with five width cuts, from compressed to extended, built around rounded sci-fi capitals.
description: Adios sets rounded, cut-corner geometric capitals across five widths, from Compressed to Extended, giving one design real range for posters and branding without changing its basic character. It reads as futuristic and slightly retro at once.
foundry_blurb: Renegadefonts pitch it simply: Adios, the white space odyssey, a font built around five widths from Compressed to Extended.

name: Binar
classification_notes: A monoline sans built from the technical hand-drawings of Czech architect Otakar Binar, offered in upright, oblique and backslanted cuts across three weights.
summary: A monoline sans tribute to Czech architect Otakar Binar, built straight from his own technical drawings.
description: Binar takes its structure from architect Otakar Binar's technical drawings and renders it as a monoline sans in three weights, each with a standard oblique and an unusual backslanted oblique cut. It suits technical, architectural or blueprint-adjacent design work.
foundry_blurb: Renegadefonts describe it as a tribute to the famous Czech architect Otakar Binar, based on his own drawings.

name: Burt
classification_notes: A very heavy, rounded display sans with no serifs, built across three weights and three widths for blunt, high-impact setting.
summary: A fat, chunky display sans named after a fire-burned sausage, in three weights and three widths.
description: Buřt takes its name, and its attitude, from a fat, wide fire-burned sausage: three weights from Regular to Fat, each cut Narrow, Standard or Wide, all built for blunt, high-impact display use.
foundry_blurb: Renegadefonts describe it plainly as fat and wide, like a fire-burned sausage.

name: Deus
classification_notes: An experimental face whose four cuts vary by shear angle rather than weight, so it sits outside the normal serif/sans construction.
summary: An experimental display face offered in four angle-cut variants rather than conventional weights.
description: Deus swaps the usual weight axis for an angle axis: four cuts (0, 45, 90 and 135 degrees) reshape the same letterforms into increasingly sheared, unconventional shapes. It is built for graphic, experimental display use rather than general setting.
foundry_blurb: Renegadefonts simply call it a font with four angle styles.

name: Hela
classification_notes: A rounded, high-contrast sans built across seven weights, extended with dedicated colour, inline and outline cuts.
summary: A high-contrast rounded display sans with an interpolation twist, plus dedicated colour, inline and outline cuts.
description: Hela runs a rounded, high-contrast display sans across seven weights, then adds a set of special cuts on top: a colour font with fill, inline and outline layers, plus standalone Inline and Outline styles. It carries the same shape through several different display treatments.
foundry_blurb: Renegadefonts describe it as a high-contrast rounded font with an interpolation twist.

name: Maso
classification_notes: A rounded, bulky novelty face with a butcher's-shop theme, offered plain and in three graduated emboss cuts, plus emoji glyphs.
summary: A chunky butcher's-shop novelty display face that ships with three levels of emboss and a set of emoji glyphs.
description: Maso leans fully into its butcher's-shop theme: rounded, bulky caps in a plain cut plus three graduated emboss versions, alongside a set of built-in emoji. It is a novelty display face for food and branding work that wants some personality.
foundry_blurb: Renegadefonts call it a butcher's font with many emojis.

name: RFAtlantic
classification_notes: A general-purpose geometric sans spanning eight weights with italics, built for wide use rather than a single themed display purpose.
summary: An eight-weight geometric sans built to travel across media, from editorial text to branding display.
description: RFAtlantic is Renegadefonts' general-purpose geometric sans, running eight weights with matching italics. Its own copy leans on travel and horizon imagery, positioning it as a flexible workhorse rather than a themed display face.
foundry_blurb: Renegadefonts describe it as where geometry meets the horizon, riding the currents of today's design, built to travel across media, across vibes, across continents.

name: Rack
classification_notes: Idiosyncratic decorative capitals with unconventional letter construction, a single-style display face rather than a text font.
summary: A single-style decorative display face of idiosyncratic capitals, built for poster and graphic use.
description: Rack came, by the foundry's own account, from an idea before sleep, and it shows: the capitals bend familiar letter construction into something more decorative and unpredictable. It is a one-off display face rather than part of a larger system.
foundry_blurb: Renegadefonts describe it only as an idea that came before sleep.

name: VelodromaTwo
classification_notes: The wide cut of the existing Velodroma family, updated with Cyrillic and Greek support; a bold, track-ready geometric sans.
summary: A bold, wide geometric sans updated with Cyrillic and Greek support, styled for sporting and motorsport-adjacent branding.
description: VelodromaTwo updates the existing Velodroma family's wide cut with Cyrillic and Greek character sets, keeping its bold, geometric, track-ready character intact for international branding use.
foundry_blurb: Renegadefonts describe it as an update to Velodroma with Cyrillic and Greek.
